answer_1.quote: Timeline summarization (TLS) aims to automatically create such timelines, i.e., temporally ordered time-stamped textual summaries of events focused on a particular topic.
answer_1.outputs: temporally ordered time-stamped textual summaries of events

answer_2.quote: In our experiments, we measure the quality of generated timelines with the following two evaluation metrics, which are also used by : • Alignment-based ROUGE F1-score: This metric compares the textual overlap between a system and a ground-truth timeline, while also considering the assignments of dates to texts. • Date F1-score: This metric compares only the dates of a system and a ground-truth timeline.
